sections.heading: Important tips
sections.body:
Announcement date: 2026.11.14 Effective date: 2026.11.14

Operator: Liu Wei, operates Watermark Master in an individual capacity (hereinafter referred to as "we"). Actual business and contact address: Qingshan District, Wuhan City, Hubei Province; contact number: 18008685441; contact email: soratani@126.com.

This agreement applies to your purchase of picture watermarks, picture refinement and related paid functions of this application through the App Store in Mainland China. Please read the product content, actual total price, service period, renewal method and refund conditions before making payment. The current version of ** provides automatic renewal subscriptions, fixed-term manual renewals and one-time buyouts. The three types of products are displayed separately and purchased according to the user's active selection and Apple's confirmation results. Purchasing fixed-term or buyout products will not automatically activate continuous deductions. **

Special reminder before purchasing **: After the purchase is successful and the corresponding rights have been activated, we do not provide no-reason refunds for personal reasons unless otherwise provided by applicable laws or Apple approves refunds in accordance with its applicable rules. Please check the package, term, total price, support scope and renewal method before confirming. **

**Release plan (confirmed):** Mainland China and all overseas countries and regions where the App Store permits sales. This is the planned distribution scope, not a statement that the app has already launched in every region. The current Chinese version is drafted based on mainland China scenarios, and applicable texts and supplementary information required for overseas issuance still need to be verified based on the actual issuance scope.

** Current service mode: ** This application currently adopts the "device local image processing + Apple transaction service + configured Supabase hosting certification" model. There is no business backend built by the developer, and there is no developer cloud work library, order ledger, notification task or custom account-deletion interface. Not having a self-built backend does not mean that there is no Internet connection, nor does it mean that third parties do not process information.

sections.heading: 1. Contract and Product Description
sections.body:
1. We provide access to this Agreement, the "User Agreement" and the "Privacy Policy" before purchasing; for the management of existing continuous subscriptions, please refer to the "Automatic Renewal Service Agreement"; when opening a new automatic renewal product, you must be clearly informed and complete the necessary authorization. Important transaction conditions should be clearly displayed on the purchase page and cannot just be hidden in the agreement.
2. You actively select the product and authorize payment through the Apple purchase confirmation process. After the transaction payment is successful and confirmed, the purchase contract is established and we shall deliver as agreed. If the payment has been deducted but the rights have not been credited, the delivery or refund responsibilities will not be waived due to failed verification.
3. Paid functions, export resolution and format, batch quantity or times, supported devices and versions, network requirements, whether an application account is required, and family sharing conditions should be listed item by item on the product page. Restrictions not expressly disclosed before purchase will not apply after purchase.
4. The specific product description, promotion commitments and special agreements at the time of purchase are important basis for determining the content of the transaction. An explicit commitment cannot be negated by backend configuration, subsequent agreement updates, or "final interpretation rights." When there is a dispute over the content of the contract, it shall be interpreted in accordance with the law and the legitimate rights and interests of consumers shall not be mechanically covered by a certain page.
5. Cloud AI, manual refinement, cloud storage, independent material packages, etc., are included in the delivery scope of the corresponding products only if they are clearly listed as rights and interests at the time of purchase.

sections.heading: 2. Commodity types and rights and interests
sections.body:
1. Fixed-term products: One-time payment corresponds to the monthly or yearly fee, and the fee will not be automatically deducted after expiration. The application calculates a natural month or year based on the effective transaction time returned by Apple on this machine. If the original date does not exist in the target month, the last day of the month is used; the status can be viewed on the application rights page. There is no independent cloud rights ledger.
2. Auto-renewal products: Users actively choose to auto-renew Tabs and monthly/annual products, and purchase them after Apple confirms authorization; subsequent deductions and renewals are handled in accordance with valid authorization and Apple's current applicable procedures. The app continues to identify valid transactions and provides read-only status and Apple's official operation path instructions. No cancellation or refund operation entrance is provided. Selecting other products or switching tabs does not mean that the original subscription has been cancelled.
3. One-time buyout of goods: One-time payment to obtain the rights to use the functions listed at the time of purchase without a fixed expiration date, and no periodic renewal fees are charged. We will not force purchased buyout features to become subscriptions simply because we launch a new version, change the business model, or stop new sales.
4. The buyout does not of course include future independent products, manual services, or features that continue to consume cloud resources that were not committed at the time of purchase; content that has been expressly promised should still be fulfilled. The original interest cannot be withdrawn on the grounds of reclassification after the sale.
5. Buyout does not guarantee that all future devices and operating systems will be permanently compatible. We should truthfully explain the scope of support and maintain it reasonably; when we are unable to perform due to service cessation or other reasons, we will provide remedies in accordance with the law based on the purchase commitment, performance status and reasons. We cannot make a general agreement that "no responsibility will be taken at the end of the life cycle".

sections.heading: 3 Price and Payment
sections.body:
1. Before purchasing, display the currency, the actual total price of the period or the product, the period and the deduction method. When displaying the converted monthly price of an annual payment product, the actual one-time annual fee is clearly displayed to avoid being understood as only paying a monthly fee.
2. If the amount on the app page and the Apple confirmation page are inconsistent, please suspend the purchase first and contact us. The Apple confirmation page is an important basis for payment authorization, but does not relieve us of our liability for mispricing, misleading advertising, or non-performance.
3. Trials and discounts are only applicable if the product is truly supported and you are eligible. It is necessary to clarify the discount period, first-issue amount, price after the discount ends, period and whether to switch to automatic payment; when there is no available trial, you must not continue to induce purchases with "free receipt".
4. Digital features of the Mainland China App Store covered by this Agreement are billed through Apple in-app purchases. We do not ask for your Apple password, payment password, verification code, or full card information to process purchases or refunds.
5. You can check your order through Apple receipts and purchase history. If we are required to provide credentials or assistance according to law, we will cooperate and will not be exempted from our obligations because of our status as an individual developer.

sections.heading: 4. Delivery and Restoration of Purchases
sections.body:
1. Confirmed valid transactions should be delivered in a timely manner; explain the situation and assist in recovery when there is a short delay, and do not require repeated payments to resolve already paid transaction issues.
2. After changing the device or reinstalling it, you can use the original Apple account you used to purchase it, and verify your rights through the application's "Restore Purchase" portal. Automatic renewals and non-consumable buyouts are restored according to valid transactions; the restoration, account binding and period accounting mechanism of fixed-term non-renewal products must be explained separately before purchase, and Apple’s native restoration does not promise to cover all product types.
3. App accounts are different from Apple accounts. Currently, Pro needs to log in to an application account. Purchased rights and interests are verified based on valid transactions in the Apple account at the time of payment, and are not exclusively bound to a single application account. Under the same purchasing Apple account, switching to other logged-in application accounts may still use or restore the purchased rights; switching Apple accounts will not inherit the original purchase. The application will not require repeated payment just for changing the application account. The application does not upload transactions to the developer's business server to establish account binding, does not register an account to receive renewal emails, and does not provide cloud order migration between application accounts. In case of mistaken association, number change or repeated purchase, please contact customer service for verification and handling.
4. Family sharing is only applicable to products that are actually supported and enabled, subject to the product page and Apple configuration, and does not exclude legal sharing allowed by the platform usage rules.
5. Purchasing software features does not convey full rights to all third-party photos, fonts, trademarks or branding materials. We should explain the scope of the license for the materials we provide ourselves and assume corresponding responsibility for the licensing of our own materials.
6. Local query or recovery is temporarily unavailable, which does not necessarily mean that you have not purchased it, nor does it guarantee that you can still use all paid functions at this time. Please check the purchase account, network, and actual transaction status; transactions that have expired, been refunded, or been canceled will not be used as the basis for continuing to grant corresponding rights and interests. Other purchases that are still valid should be verified separately. The recovery scope and period calculation of fixed-term products after reinstallation or replacement still need to be actually verified. The presence of a "Resume Purchase" button cannot be regarded as a successful verification of all scenarios.
7. Deleting an app account does not delete Apple purchase records, nor does it automatically cancel renewals or result in a refund; however, currently Pro requires logging in to an app account, and paid features that require logging in cannot be used without logging in after the account is deleted. When using another logged-in application account again, the purchased rights will still be verified according to the valid transaction and actual recoverable range of the original Apple account. There is no commitment that the post-paid function can continue to be used in a non-logged-in state after deleting the account. We do not make account deletion conditional on the subscription having expired, prior cancellation of the subscription, or waiver of a refund.

sections.heading: 5. Cancellation, renewal, expiration and platform handling
sections.body:
1. This App does not provide cancellation of subscriptions, refund applications and corresponding platform jump operations. If you have an automatic renewal subscription, please go to iPhone "Settings → Apple account name at the top → Subscriptions → Corresponding products → Cancel subscription", or follow Apple's official instructions. The Apple account used for purchase must be verified, and the cancellation confirmation and expiration status displayed by Apple shall prevail; simply exiting a page does not mean that it has been cancelled.
2. Cancellation of automatic renewal usually stops the next and subsequent renewals. Normal paid benefits usually continue until the end of the current validity period and are not cleared immediately due to cancellation. Do not understand this as "cancellation cannot be performed until the next cycle" or that the deduction will inevitably be reversed; if Apple has already started to process the deduction when the renewal is approaching, you must check the actual bill to see whether a new cycle will occur, and you can contact Apple or us for assistance in verifying any abnormalities. Free or discounted trials, refunds, cancellations, and local special rules may be handled differently, and the actual applicable rules shall prevail.
3. Manual renewal of a fixed-term subscription is not an automatic renewal subscription: there is no need to turn off renewal in Apple Subscription Management. When you no longer actively purchase, the benefits will end after the current validity period expires, and the next period's fee will not be automatically deducted just because of non-cancellation. The absence of such items in the subscription list does not mean that the transaction does not exist, nor does it constitute a refund. A one-time buyout does not generate periodic renewals, and there is no cancellation or renewal operation.
4. Cancellation of future renewals and requesting a refund for paid orders are two separate matters. There is no automatic refund for cancellation, and submitting a refund application does not mean that future renewals have been cancelled. If you do not want to continue renewal, please check the status of your Apple subscription by yourself at the same time. Purchasing a buyout, uninstalling, logging out, or deleting an app account will not automatically cancel existing Apple auto-renewal subscriptions.
5. You can keep necessary information such as Apple order number, purchase account, debit and cancellation confirmation time for troubleshooting, and do not provide us with passwords or verification codes. If the payment has been deducted but the rights have not been credited, first use the original Apple account to try to "restore the purchase" or contact customer service. You are not required to make repeated payments or delete your account before filing a dispute. We provide necessary assistance and assume our own delivery and remedial responsibilities in accordance with the law.
6. Apple's official cancellation instructions: https://support.apple.com/118428; refund instructions: https://support.apple.com/118223. The above are official addresses that can be checked outside the App. It does not mean that the App has provided a processing button or jump. Specific paths, trials, and region-specific rules should be checked with Apple's currently applicable instructions.

sections.heading: 6. Post-purchase refund policy and exceptions
sections.body:
**This application does not provide additional commercial no-reason refund commitments. After the purchase is successful and the corresponding benefits have been activated, refunds for personal reasons only are not supported unless otherwise provided by applicable laws or Apple approves refunds in accordance with its applicable rules. This policy does not exclude your rights to rescission, refund, redress and compensation under the law. **

1. When the product information has been clearly disclosed, the purchase is validly authorized, the rights and interests are provided as agreed, and there are no legal reasons for refund, we will not accept no-reason refunds based on personal reasons such as change of mind, no longer needed, low frequency of use, not yet used, personal aesthetic or preference changes, etc., nor will we proactively refund the difference based on the number of unused times or remaining days. Whether there is legal right should be judged based on the specific transaction facts, and verification cannot be refused based on this paragraph alone.
2. Please check the functions, export specifications, compatible devices, service period, actual total price and whether to automatically renew before purchasing; we should provide true, clear and understandable instructions, and prominently display this refund policy before payment. Click-to-purchase or system payment confirmation does not of course replace other prompts, confirmations or valid authorizations required by law, and it cannot be inferred that you have waived your legal rights.
3. Canceling automatic renewal means turning off subsequent renewals. It does not mean waiting for the next cycle to start before submitting a cancellation, nor does it mean reversing the current paid transaction; after successful cancellation, the status, expiration time and applicable rules confirmed by Apple will prevail. Cancellation does not automatically refund fees for already paid periods. The normally provided payment cycle can generally be used until expiration; except for refunds, cancellations or other adjustments in accordance with the law. Logging out, uninstalling, or canceling your account will not automatically result in a refund or cancellation of your Apple subscription.
4. For repeated deductions, deductions without valid authorization, non-delivery after payment, services that obviously do not meet the commitments, failure to fulfill the obligation of significant reminders for renewal, inability to continue to perform the contract due to our reasons, and other situations that should be remedied according to law, we will still verify and provide repair, restoration, redoing, refund of corresponding fees or compensation in accordance with the law. Whether various types of disputes constitute grounds for refund shall be based on specific facts and applicable laws. Submitting a request does not guarantee an unconditional full refund.
5. For orders settled through the App Store, you can still submit a refund request through https://reportaproblem.apple.com/ in accordance with Apple's applicable rules. Approval and payment are handled by Apple and the payment channel in accordance with their processes. We cannot guarantee approval, make decisions on behalf of Apple, or prevent platform review with this agreement. We should provide necessary assistance and assume our own responsibilities in accordance with the law; this App does not provide refund application buttons, refund forms or refund jumps, nor does it submit, approve refunds or operate Apple accounts on behalf of users; please handle it yourself through Apple's official channels. The lack of an in-app operation portal does not mean that you have no refund application or legal relief channels.
6. Whether the 7-day no-reason return rule or other rescission rules apply depends on the nature of the transaction, the delivery method, the required notices and confirmations, and applicable law. Their blanket inapplicability must not be presumed solely because the product is described as a digital feature. There is no additional no-reason refund commitment, and it does not affect legal rights such as quality discrepancy, fraud, breach of contract, etc.
7. The authorization, validity and refund of purchases by minors are judged in accordance with the law and are not only valid based on login, device unlocking or successful payment. The verification only collects necessary information and does not require giving up of complaints as a condition for processing.
8. After the refund is effectively confirmed, the refunded rights can be adjusted or terminated according to the corresponding transaction scope; partial refunds cannot be used to cancel other valid purchases. We do not penalize your account or refuse irrelevant services because you legally apply for a refund, nor do we promise to delete files that have been exported to your album. Refund disputes are handled separately from remaining valid purchases.
9. After receiving the actual complaint, we will verify and respond in accordance with applicable legal requirements and the complexity of the matter. If additional information is required or the processing is extended, the reasons and expected arrangements will be explained; we will not promise automatic receipts or fixed processing time limits that we cannot support, and will not affect the statutory deadlines.

sections.heading: 7. Adjustment, interruption and suspension of operations
sections.body:
1. The core rights and interests during the paid period shall not be substantially reduced by one party. If adjustments are indeed necessary and affect performance of the contract, notice will be given prominently in advance and options such as reasonable substitutions, reasonable remedies, or refunds in accordance with the law will be provided.
2. If it is unavailable for a long time due to our reasons, we should take into account the impact to take repairs, assist in recovery, refund according to law and other remedies; we do not promise to automatically modify the Apple subscription period. Whether third-party faults are exempt is determined according to law, and the user, Apple or the cloud service provider is not always responsible.
3. When voluntarily terminating online trading activities, a prominent announcement must be made on the main business page at least 30 days in advance in accordance with the law, explaining the cessation of sales, existing rights and interests, refunds, data export and contact arrangements; announcements cannot replace the settlement of unfulfilled obligations.
4. The unperformed part of the term service shall be settled in accordance with the law; reasonable efforts shall be made to maintain the use conditions of the delivered local functions for the buyout. If performance cannot continue, the matter will be handled in accordance with the law; we do not presume that all buyout fees are non-refundable.

sections.heading: 8. Responsibilities and Disputes
sections.body:
1. Both parties shall bear liability in accordance with the law and their respective faults. Liability for personal injury, property damage caused by intentional or gross negligence, personal information infringement and other non-exempt matters shall not be excluded. There is no upper limit on compensation that is always limited to the amount paid.
2. This agreement shall be governed by the laws of the mainland of the People's Republic of China. You can negotiate, complain to consumer organizations or regulatory authorities, or file a lawsuit with a people's court with jurisdiction according to law; contacting customer service does not constitute a prerequisite for statutory relief.
3. We will prominently notify you of material changes and will not retroactively reduce purchased benefits. Continued use does not automatically constitute agreement to new charges, automatic renewal, or new uses of personal information.

sections.heading: 1. Activation and authorization
sections.body:
1. Automatic renewal means that you actively choose products such as continuous monthly subscription, continuous annual subscription, etc. After confirming the purchase through Apple, you authorize renewal, charging and continuation of benefits in subsequent periods under the valid conditions of that product.
2. Before activation, the purchase page should clearly display the subscription name, paid benefits, cycle length, actual total amount payable per cycle, trial or first period discount, price after the discount ends, cancellation method and agreement link. You cannot only display the converted monthly price and hide the annual fee, nor can you use "free" to hide the automatic conversion to paid billing.
3. Do not use default check boxes, hidden product swaps, blurred buttons, or hidden cancellation portals to obtain authorization. Merely agreeing to the User Agreement, logging in or using paid functions does not serve as proof that you have activated automatic deductions.
4. Authorization is limited to clearly selected products, periods and validity conditions, and does not extend to other applications, unrelated services or new charges. Matters requiring re-confirmation shall require separate authorization.

sections.heading: Two cycles and deductions
sections.body:
1. Subscriptions are provided according to the monthly, yearly and other cycles confirmed on the purchase page. The start, expiration and next renewal information are based on the valid transaction status and can be checked on the benefits page or Apple subscription management page.
2. Normal renewals are processed in accordance with Apple's current applicable rules and valid authorization. Apple may start billing before the end of the current cycle; deduction attempts, retries, grace periods and equity status are based on actual transactions, and does not promise that all products will be deducted exactly 24 hours before expiration.
3. To avoid incomplete operations near the end, it is recommended that you cancel as early as possible; if you do not want to convert the free or discounted trial to paid, please cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the trial. This advice does not limit your legal right to cancel or change at any time.
4. Failure to renew may cause retry or service interruption. We will not charge additional fees for transactions without valid authorization, nor will we charge liquidated damages, handling fees and other unreasonable fees for canceling future renewals.

sections.heading: 3. Free trials and offers
sections.body:
1. It only takes effect if the product is truly supported and you meet the conditions. The trial duration, end time, amount payable when the trial converts to paid service, period and discount qualification must be displayed prominently before activation and be consistent with the final confirmation.
2. When the trial is bound to automatic renewal, failure to cancel in time will result in payment according to clearly stated conditions; you cannot just highlight free and hide this consequence.
3. Benefits may be lost immediately after the free or discounted trial is cancelled, subject to the rules clearly displayed and applicable at the time of activation. If you cancel future renewals in the normal paid period, you can usually use it until expiration; changes in rights and interests caused by refunds, cancellations, etc. will be handled separately.

sections.heading: 4. Renewal Reminder and Current Capacity
sections.body:
1. When the app opens the relevant page or re-enters the foreground, and Apple can return to the status, it will locally query and display the expected renewal date, automatic renewal status, and Apple's official operation path instructions; this information is read-only and does not include cancellation or refund application buttons, nor does it jump to the processing page. This is in-app auxiliary information, not a scheduled backend touch; the displayed date is not guaranteed to be equal to the actual start time of deductions. Please go to Apple Subscription Management to check the actual amount in the next period. The current new purchase price cannot be used to replace the existing subscription renewal price.
2. There is currently no developer email/SMS mass sending system, push server, scheduled task, notification sending record or failure retry service, and there is no background local notification arrangement. When the application is closed, not opened for a long time, disconnected from the Internet, or the status is unavailable, we cannot guarantee that the auxiliary prompt will still be accessible.
3. Apple may provide system or email notifications in accordance with its applicable rules, which shall be subject to its actual service; the application does not describe it as being sent by the developer itself, nor is it presumed that any Apple notification is sufficient to replace the operator's reminder obligations.
4. The current source code provides an automatic renewal purchase process, but it does not mean that the reminder obligation has been verified. Reminder channels and conspicuity, price and date information, reach and necessary remediation must still be verified before actual issuance; the ability to implement actual needs through the platform or other solutions will not be exempted from legal obligations due to "no self-built backend", the resumption of the purchase process or the text of the agreement.
5. Administration, assistance and applicable legal responsibilities for existing subscriptions remain. Disputes arising from failure to provide appropriate reminders should be verified based on the authorization, reminder and deduction facts and handled in accordance with the law; all risks should not be passed on to the user.
6. Reminders and cancellation instructions should be provided prominently in accordance with the law before accepting the automatic renewal service and before the renewal date, and you cannot only rely on you to review this agreement on your own. This Agreement does not promise regular reminders that have not yet been realized, nor does your agreement to this Agreement mean that you waive the right to reminder or simple cancellation.

sections.heading: 5. Cancellation and changes
sections.body:
1. iPhone operation: Open "Settings", tap the name at the top, enter "Subscriptions", select the corresponding product Watermark Master, then tap "Cancel Subscription" and check the expiration or cancellation status. Depending on the system version, the text or location may change slightly.
2. This App does not provide cancellation or refund application operations, nor does it modify Apple subscription status on behalf of users, nor does it provide corresponding jump buttons; it only displays status and official path instructions. Users handle it through Apple Subscription Management themselves and do not need to contact customer service, purchase other products, delete accounts or provide irrelevant identity materials as a prerequisite for cancellation. The absence of an in-app button does not change the fulfillment obligations of existing subscriptions; whether it meets the cancellation convenience requirements of the actual issuing region still needs to be verified.
3. If you cannot find your subscription, you can check the purchase account on the Apple receipt, follow Apple's official guidelines or contact us to troubleshoot. We cannot operate your Apple account for you, but we should provide necessary assistance.
4. ** Uninstalling the app, logging out, revoking album permissions, deactivating the device or deleting the app account will not automatically cancel your Apple subscription. ** Before account deletion, we should explain existing subscriptions and how to cancel them. We must not use them to obstruct account deletion or require you to wait until the paid period ends.
5. Successful cancellation of automatic renewal usually prevents the next and subsequent renewals. Normal paid benefits are usually available until the end of the current validity period. You do not have to wait until the next period begins to submit a cancellation, nor does it mean that the current paid transaction is cancelled. When the renewal operation is approaching, you must check whether Apple has processed the deduction and confirmed the actual cancellation; it does not promise that the next period of deduction that has occurred will be cancelled. Free or discounted trials, refunds, cancellations and special rules in some regions may be different, and the actual applicable rules shall prevail. Cancellation does not automatically refund; applying for a refund does not mean that the renewal has been cancelled. Please check the results separately and retain the necessary confirmation information.
6. Manual renewal for a fixed period does not automatically deduct the next period's fee. You can just stop purchasing at the expiration date without canceling. There is no need to cancel if you buy out the subscription and there is no renewal. Upgrading, downgrading, and switching cycles are not cancellations of renewals. Their effective time and fee processing are subject to the specific transaction rules confirmed by Apple. We do not promise that all such changes take effect in the next period. Purchasing a buyout does not guarantee automatic termination of the original subscription; if there are still subscriptions, you should be reminded to check and cancel to avoid repeated expenditures.

You can check it by yourself outside the App. The specific steps, trial and regional special rules are checked according to the current applicable instructions; listing the address does not mean that the App has provided a cancellation or refund jump.
8. The application only delivers corresponding rights and interests based on valid transactions available locally. It does not continue to consider expiration, refund or cancellation transactions as valid, nor does it consider the cancellation of future renewals as the immediate end of the normal paid cycle. When the status is temporarily unavailable or does not match the bill, the original Apple account for purchase should be verified and necessary assistance will be provided without requiring repeated payment. Currently, Pro needs to log in to the application account; after deleting the account and not logging in, you cannot use the functions that require login. The recovery scope after re-logging in to other application accounts is verified by the "Purchase Agreement" and the valid transactions of the original Apple account.

sections.heading: 6. Changes in Prices and Terms
sections.body:
1. Price changes will be notified in accordance with applicable laws and Apple rules; if your consent is required, confirmation will not be replaced by silence, opening the app again, or pre-authorization of this agreement. When valid authorization is not completed, the unauthorized new price will not be charged.
2. Some Apple price adjustments may be subject to the effective-after-notification process. We still fulfill our legal obligations, explain the methods of changes and cancellations, and do not interpret the platform mechanism to mean that prices can be increased arbitrarily.
3. The core rights and interests of the purchased period will not be unilaterally reduced due to the renewal terms. If you do not agree to the subsequent new conditions, you can cancel future renewals and claim redress according to law for the unfulfilled portion.

sections.heading: 7. Refund Liability and Disputes

1. 3. You can still apply for a refund through Apple's applicable process, the review results will be handled by Apple in accordance with its rules, and we do not guarantee approval or block the review under this Agreement. After the refund is confirmed to be valid, the rights will only be adjusted according to the corresponding transaction and will not affect other valid purchases. If we are unable to perform due to our reasons, we will restore, repair or refund according to the situation; changes involving Apple bills and deadlines will be assisted according to the available process on the platform, and there is no commitment that the application can directly rewrite platform transactions. Successful payment processing does not, by itself, make an unauthorized transaction valid.
4. Generally, complaints will be manually verified by the actual customer service after receipt and the progress will be informed. If the complaint should be handled within the prescribed time limit according to the law, the regulations will follow; there is no promise of automatic back-end receipt or unconfirmed fixed processing time limit.
5. This agreement shall be governed by the laws of the mainland of the People's Republic of China. You can negotiate, complain, mediate or file a lawsuit in a court with jurisdiction according to law; it does not agree on the exclusive jurisdiction of the developer's domicile and does not exclude statutory remedies.

sections.heading: 2. Account Purchase and Customer Service
sections.body:
### Register and log in

When the Supabase project is configured, email registration, verification code verification and login directly use Supabase Auth to handle email, necessary authentication information, account identification, session and secure connection records. The authentication password is submitted to the authentication service through an encrypted connection and is not stored in clear text in the application's local data, nor should it be submitted to customer service.

Apple login receives a user ID, name, or email actually authorized by Apple; when managed authentication is configured, the identity token is verified by Supabase, otherwise the native data scheme currently supported by the application is used. Whether Apple's hidden mailbox is available is subject to actual authorization. App doesn't get Apple password.

Local account information may be saved in SecureStore; Supabase sessions are saved by the local storage currently configured by the SDK, and all session storage cannot be collectively referred to as SecureStore encryption. The managed authentication service may still save account and login security records, and logging out or uninstalling will not automatically delete these data.

The current basic watermark function can be used without logging in, while the Pro and purchase/restoration processes require application account login; refusing to provide non-essential avatars and other information will not affect functions that do not rely on this information. The data is not used to create cloud photo files or cloud order migration.

### Purchase and Equity

Apps use Apple StoreKit to query valid purchases, product identification, purchase or expiration time, and refund/revocation status on the device for delivery and restoration of benefits. The fixed period is calculated based on the effective transaction time available on this machine; there is no additional developer cloud transaction verification or account rights database.

The purchased rights follow the Apple account used for payment and are not exclusively bound to a certain application account. Apple's transaction and purchase records are managed by Apple; apps do not receive full bank card, Apple password, or payment passwords for in-app purchases. The current version does not additionally upload transaction identifiers or register recipient email addresses for sending reminders.

### Customer service and deletion request

The customer service portal or account deletion application portal will request the system to open the mail application and prefill the subject; the account deletion draft only includes the application account ID, login method and request instructions known to the machine, and does not include passwords, verification codes, identity tokens or photo attachments. Users still need to check and send it themselves. Opening a draft does not mean that the request has been sent, accepted, or processed.

Customer service emails are received through soratani@126.com in the 126 mailbox, automatic forwarding is not enabled, and other customer service platforms are not connected; account deletion applications use the same receiving channel. Customer service emails and account deletion applications will be reviewed and manually processed by the operator Liu Wei himself in mainland China. We process the actual receipt of the sending address, a description of the request, and the information necessary to resolve the issue; the external mail provider also processes the mail according to their rules. The manual processing location does not mean that the email service provider's server or support access is only located in mainland China, and the latter still needs to be verified separately. There is no back-end work order system, automatic SLA timing or deletion receipt service. There is no commitment to query the remote processing progress in the App; confirm the progress and results by replying to emails or contacting us separately. Attachments such as ordinary customer service emails and problem screenshots will be deleted after the problem is resolved; materials involving order receipts, refund disputes or complaints are separately distinguished. There is currently no fixed retention period. The specific retention basis, period and deletion conditions still need to be clarified before release. This cannot be written as a permanent storage commitment. The above deletion rules are for data controllable by the operator, and do not mean that all backups of the email service provider will be deleted at the same time.

### Manually exported data held by the operator

The operator once manually exported the user ID, email address or personal data from the managed account data, and it is still retained on Liu Wei’s device in mainland China without cloud synchronization or backup. These data are used for user information verification and will be deleted after use; when applying for account deletion, the exported data corresponding to the user will also be cleared. It is a copy of personal information held separately by the operator. It is not a cloud work library, and it is not exempt from the protection and deletion obligations stated in this policy because it does not have a self-built business backend.
